Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about hosting your site in United Kingdom.

Would you be able to help me move my website over?
Yes, we offer free migration services. Our team of industry experts will handle the entire process to ensure a hassle-free transition to our managed hosting.
How can disk space be unlimited?
Our unlimited plans use high-capacity SSD/NVMe drives on top-tier infrastructure. While 'unlimited' implies no hard caps for normal usage, it's subject to our fair use policy to ensure performance for all users.
What billing cycles do you offer?
We offer monthly, annually, and multi-year billing cycles. You can save up to 15-20% by opting for longer-term billing plans.
